rationale: C06 plausibly supplied a material template for the child: both are short presidential greetings to a major labor brotherhood on a ceremonial milestone, move from identifying the occasion to praising free trade unionism as strengthening American economic and social life, and close with best wishes to the organization. The child substantially expands this framework with discussion of craftsmanship, apprenticeship, production, security, and leadership. C09 is a secondary possibility because it concerns another organization's seventy-fifth anniversary and uses an occasion-praise-contribution-celebration structure, but its fundraising and agency-directed machinery differ. C05 likewise uses an anniversary to recognize institutional and individual contributions, but concerns foreign aid rather than organized labor and is less closely matched in form and rhetoric.

shared_material.child_excerpt: As the United Brotherhood of Carpenters and Joiners marks its Diamond Jubilee Year, I salute this international trade union
shared_material.parent_excerpt: The International Brotherhood of Teamsters has erected in our Capital a magnificent building to serve the growing needs of a growing union.
shared_material.explanation: Both open by naming an International Brotherhood and the ceremonial occasion prompting the presidential greeting.

shared_material.child_excerpt: Such unions have done much to promote a rising standard of living for American wage earners and thus. to further the economic and social progress of the Nation.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: Our democracy and our economy both make possible and draw strength from free trade unions.
shared_material.explanation: Both present free trade unions as contributors to the nation's economic and social strength.

shared_material.child_excerpt: I wish all of you a happy Seventy-fifth Anniversary and continued success in the years to come.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: To the International Brotherhood of Teamsters, its officers and members, I extend my best wishes on the dedication of their new home.
shared_material.explanation: Both close by extending wishes to the brotherhood and its membership on the commemorated event.
